title: Introduce Cohort Sensitivity Calibrator CI Hook
author: Priya Malhotra
description:
Summary: Adds a CI hook that measures per-cohort sensitivity to controlled prompt perturbations and surfaces unstable cohorts as gating failures. The new "cohort sensitivity calibrator" complements existing drift and variance detectors by focusing on whether small, realistic prompt edits cause disproportionate metric swings (e.g., accuracy, F1, embedding similarity). Motivation: During a recent canary we observed acceptable mean metrics while several important cohorts (non-native English, short prompts, and instruction-prefix variants) flipped labels under minimal rephrasing. Existing variance detectors surface high volatility but do not explicitly quantify directional sensitivity to realistic prompt perturbations. This hook provides a repeatable calibration test to catch regressions that are brittle to prompt-formatting and phrasing changes.

What changed:
- New CI hook: ci/hooks/sensitivity-ci.yml wires the calibrator into the eval pipeline as an opt-in gate for PRs touching evaluation code or models.
- Core implementation: hooks/sensitivity_calibrator.py implements perturbation generators (synonym swap, punctuation/noise, instruction reframe), batch-run sensitivity scoring, cohort bucketing, and an aggregator that computes sensitivity percentiles and a cohort-level stability score.
- Config: hooks/configs/sensitivity.yaml documents per-cohort tolerances, min-sample thresholds, baseline-window (N=30 historical runs), and exemption rules for low-sample cohorts.
- Reporter: ci/reports/sensitivity_reporter.py produces a concise CI artifact (CSV + JSON) and a human-readable summary in the PR checks UI with links to failing prompts.
- Tests & docs: tests/test_sensitivity.py with small synthetic fixtures and docs/quality_gates.md with usage guidance and remediation suggestions.

Commits (high-level):
- 8f3a2b4: initial calibrator harness, baseline loader and aggregator
- 3c1b6d1: add perturbation generators and unit tests
- 2d9e7f0: CI hook wiring + reporter and ci artifact upload
- 7a5c0a1: docs, additional edge-case tests, flake fixes

What I validated locally and in CI:
- Unit tests for generator determinism and aggregator stability.
- Integration test against a small model snapshot (mocked scoring) to validate reporting format.
- End-to-end run in the feature branch CI with a seeded baseline to reproduce failing cohorts.

Files changed (high-level): hooks/sensitivity_calibrator.py, hooks/configs/sensitivity.yaml, ci/hooks/sensitivity-ci.yml, ci/reports/sensitivity_reporter.py, tests/test_sensitivity.py, docs/quality_gates.md

Review conversation summary:
- Evan Zhou (review): "Nice addition. Can you make the perturbation list extensible via config so infra teams can add vendor-specific transforms? Also please add a brief performance note (latency/compute) for the CI job."
- Priya: "Made transforms configurable and added perf note to the YAML + docs. See commit 7a5c0a1."
- Marta Ruiz (review): "The cohort bucketing logic looks good, but we should avoid gating on cohorts with < 15 samples. Suggest a configurable min_sample threshold and a clear rollout path."
- Priya: "Added min_sample threshold and a gradual rollout note in the docs; default is 30 samples. I also added an exemption list for intentionally brittle cohorts."
- Jonah Park (approve): "LGTM after tests pass. The reporter CSV is useful for manual triage."
- Automated CI bot: initial run failed (test_flaky_perturbation_seed) — root cause was nondeterministic random seed in one unit test; fixed in 7a5c0a1.

Release notes: "Adds a new evaluation CI gate: Cohort Sensitivity Calibrator. Enables per-cohort sensitivity checks against prompt perturbations. Default behavior is opt-in via repo config. Teams should configure per-cohort tolerances and min-sample thresholds before enabling the gate for production runs. See docs/quality_gates.md for migration steps."

Rollout and operational notes:
- Default is opt-in; to enable globally update .eval-ci-config.yml to include ci/hooks/sensitivity-ci.yml
- It is compute heavier than a single eval pass because it runs perturbation variants; recommend running on dedicated CI workers and enabling caching for model artifacts.
- For initial 2-week rollout keep gate in 'warn' mode (report-only) and monitor false positives; the hook supports a 'warn-only' reporter mode configured via sensitivity.yaml.

Related work:
- Complements ENG-9123 (historical variance detector) and ENG-9280 (cohort prioritizer).
- Useful input for model onboarding and prompt engineering fixes.

Merge: Squash-merged to main after CI green and approvals.

Notes: No breaking changes. Documented config defaults and added an enterprise exemption mechanism for private cohorts.
